source_text.body:
Debloat an Android TV
Rakesh Prakash asked his Hermes agent to debloat his Android TV and it completed the task successfully.
·
Oct 13, 2026
Done with
HA
Hermes Agent
What they did
Rakesh Prakash asked his Hermes agent to debloat his Android TV. The agent completed the task on its own.
How it went
It just worked.
Try it yourself
with
Hermes Agent
Copy prompt
Debloat my Android TV, which is a [brand and model] connected at [IP address] with ADB debugging enabled. First list the preinstalled apps you think are safe to remove or disable, and pause so I can review the list. After I approve, disable or uninstall only those apps, confirm the TV still boots and works, and give me a record of everything you changed so I can undo it.
Original source: https://x.com/rakeshprakash09/status/2109827195472642538
